gallery.title: Clips
gallery.empty: No clips yet. Capture engine lands in Phase 3.
gallery.coming: Gallery arrives in Phase 2–3. This is the Phase 1 shell.

audio.title: Capture audio
audio.no_signal: No signal from the selected device
audio.save_tracks_note: Saved clips carry 3 tracks: Mix, Game, Mic. Mix is first and the only enabled one by default.
audio.single_track_hint: Maximum compatibility: any player plays the Mix. The file loses the Game and Mic tracks.
audio.single_track_note: Saved clips will carry only the Mix track, playable in any player.
audio.stopped_hint: Start the buffer to link audio tracks.

video.title: Recording video
video.codec_x264_note: Encodes on the processor: pick it if GPU encoding fails or you prefer it; heavier, consider 720p/30 fps.
video.transcoding_note: Records at source, delivers with lanczos on save (sharp text).
video.upscale_warn: Above your monitor: heavier file, zero extra detail.
video.disk_note: Lower resolutions only save disk space. For maximum quality use Source.
video.judder_note: 30 fps saves GPU but judders more on high-refresh monitors; 60 fps is smoother for action.
video.estimate: CBR {{bitrate}} kbps · ~{{ram}} MB per 60 s in RAM
video.hq_note: Fixed HQ: CBR + P7 + high quality + AQ (verified NVENC recipe, no knobs to turn).
video.caps_missing: KMS capture permission is missing: the system will ask for admin on every capture start.

settings.hotkey_needs_mod: Use a modifier (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Super) or a function key (F1–F12).

secret.title: Secret vault (OS keyring)
secret.ok: Vault OK: store → read → delete succeeded.

games.picker_note: Running-process picker and click-to-register arrive in Phase 4.

quality.title: Quality
quality.over_2min: Over 2 min: you need ~{{ram}} MB of RAM and the save will weigh ~{{save}} MB. At your own risk.
quality.ram_low: Warning: estimated RAM exceeds your free RAM minus 1 GB.
quality.fps_clamped: V1 uses 30 or 60 fps: {{fps}} will be applied.
quality.restart_notice: Changing codec, resolution, fps, monitor, container or duration restarts the buffer with a notice.
quality.capture_cap_hint: Lowering the cap reduces GPU load when the game is tight (Auto = 2× the fps).
quality.faststart_hint: Doubles save I/O; enable only if you upload or stream the clip.
quality.gpu_scale_note: Live GPU scaling: the buffer already runs at the delivered resolution (copy-only saves).

wizard.title: Pick your moon
wizard.subtitle: We detected your GPU and suggest a preset. You can change it anytime in Settings.
wizard.ram_note: Estimated cost with a 30 s buffer: ~{{ram}} MB of RAM.
